text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Cost is GBP 2,000 per MWh of farm output cut plus the risk ratio times the MWh still over the limit, per MW of farm capacity beneath the bulk and grid supply points, per day, July 2025 to June 2026. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Below zero is a lower cost than NGED's method as we understand it (unconfirmed). This is a fit to history, not a saving.'
text.tspan: Cost is GBP 2,000 per MWh of farm output cut plus the risk ratio times the MWh still over the limit, per MW
of farm capacity beneath the bulk and grid supply points, per day, July 2025 to June 2026. Dot: estimate.
Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Below zero is a lower cost than NGED's method as we
understand it (unconfirmed). This is a fit to history, not a saving.
